text:
emily_finance: FYI invoice INV-2026-00781 from MeridianAI hit AP but Coupa didn't match a PO. Total $18,720 — subscription $3,720, inference usage $15,000. Who owns approvals for this vendor?

harry_procure: pulling PO registry now. I only see PO-55421 for a pilot bench. That PO explicitly excluded on-demand usage. :thinking_face:

emily_finance: Vendor attached a handwritten note with 'PO 55421' but it's not on the invoice header. OCR failed. They also sent a CSV with usage details in the invoice record.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Invoice INV-2026-00781 uploaded by emily_finance. Status -> payment_hold (missing validated PO).

diane_ops: If this is runtime usage it should go to cost center 342-Platform-Infra. @nikhil_prod can confirm approver; historically he approves MeridianAI spend.

nikhil_prod: I'm out today but can approve a retrospective PO. Need the hourly breakdown, region and effective rates to sanity-check totals. Can you paste the vendor breakdown here, @emily_finance?

emily_finance: Pasting vendor CSV excerpt: 

```
date,region,hours,rate_per_hour,amount
2026-02-05,us-east,1200,0.50,600.00
2026-02-06,eu-west,1400,10.00,14000.00
2026-02-20,us-east,300,9.40,2820.00
```

harry_procure: Thanks. Procurement preference: vendor should reissue with PO on invoice header for audit. For immediate payment, we can issue a retro/internal PO and then request the vendor reissue for our records. I'll create PO-R-2026-242 and route to @nikhil_prod.

emily_finance: Confirm GL 5002 (CloudCompute) and cost center 342. Finance will make an interim accrual. Vendor asked for net 10, any chance to hit that if we create the PO today?

diane_ops: I'll mark the payment hold to auto-release on PO approval. If Procurement creates the PO and routes it now, we should be able to meet net10.

harry_procure: Created PO-R-2026-242 (internal retro PO) — supplier MeridianAI — routing set to nikhil_prod, notes: retrospective inference usage for Feb.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: PO PO-R-2026-242 created by harry_procure. Invoice INV-2026-00781 linked to PO-R-2026-242. Payment hold set until approval.

nikhil_prod: Approved PO-R-2026-242. Quick note: rates look odd for eu-west row, I pinged vendor to ask for region-rate confirmation; hold notes in Coupa.

acct_bot: SYSTEM: Approval recorded. Payment hold removed. Invoice scheduled for payment: Net 7 from approval. Finance posted an interim accrual journal for $18,720.

emily_finance: Thanks all. I'll ask vendor to reissue with PO on header and confirm the EU rate line-item. Closing once payment posts. :white_check_mark:
